name: Release v0.9.5
body:
## Snow CLI v0.9.5

### What's New

- New Resource Manager panel (`/taskmanager`): monitor CPU and memory usage of the main process and its child processes, and terminate processes directly from the panel
- MCP tool discovery: two-track catalog JIT architecture removes discovery latency, keeps the LLM prompt cache intact (no more 5-minute TTL timer), and collapses concurrent probing into a single flight
- AskUserQuestion: restored the multi-select contract and fixed an interaction deadlock (#220)
- Thinking output: markdown code fences are protected and newlines are preserved when cleaning thinking content (#216)
- Anthropic: added a display option for the new adaptive thinking models so reasoning text is visible in streaming responses
- Anthropic OAuth: subscription requests now use the Claude Code beta endpoint and client headers, fixing 404 errors; model list requests no longer duplicate the /v1 path segment
- Developer: established the TUI component testing conventions and infrastructure (#222)

### Installation
```bash
npm install -g snow-ai
```

### Usage
```bash
snow
```
### Update
```bash
snow --update
```
